completenessNote: 来源为 AGC 官方 PDF《S-5_2026-E.pdf》（3 页），本次切分 2 条。该 PDF 为扫描件 + OCR 文本层，正文按版式位置重建：已剔除页眉页脚与边栏条标题、回接折行；未改写措辞、未增删内容。OCR 层面可能存在个别粘连或形近字，逐字引用请以原始 PDF 为准。

text.en: This Order may be cited as the Law Revision Order No. 1 of 2026 and shall commence on the day it is made. Removal and substitution of pages

(1) The removal from the Laws is hereby directed of the pages specified in the third column of Part A of the Schedule hereto with reference to the written laws specified in the first and second columns thereof and bearing on the face or overleaf the legend specified in the fourth column thereof.

(2) The inclusion in the Laws is hereby authorised, in substitution of the pages directed to be removed under subparagraph (1), of the pages specified in the third column of Part B of the Schedule and bearing on the face or overleaf the legend specified in the fourth column thereof, with reference to the written laws referred to in the first and second columns thereof. 5th. FEBRUARY, 2026

SCHEDULE (paragraph 2)

REMOVAL FROM AND INCLUSION IN LAWS

PART A Chapter Title Pages Legend 167 Employee Trust Act 1 to 36 B.L.R.O. 1/2019 Rg 1 Employee Trust (Rates of 1 to 6 B.L.R.O. 1/2019 Contributions) Regulations R 1 Employee Trust Rules 1 to 12 B.L.R.O. 112019 211 Compulsory Education Act 1 to 8 B.L.R.O. 7/2011 233 Energy Efficiency (Standards and 1 to 26 B.L.R.O. 3/2022 Labelling) Act 276 Supplemental Contributory Pensions 1 to 34 B.L.R.O. 3/2024 Trust Act R 1 Supplemental Contributory 1 to 14 B.L.R.O. 3/2024. Pensions Trust Rules

PARTE Chapter Title Pages Legend 167 Employee Trust Act 1 to 36 B.L.R.O. 1/2026 Rg 1 Employee Trust (Rates of 1 to 6 B.L.R.O. 1/2026 Contributions) Regulations R1 Employee Trust Rules 1 to 12 B.L.R.O. 1/2026 211 Compulsory Education Act 1 to 10 B.L.R.O. 1/2026 233 Energy Efficiency (Standards and 1 to 26 B.L.R.O. 1/2026 Labelling) Act 276 Supplemental Contributory Pensions 1 to 34 B.L.R.O. 1/2026 Trust Act R1 Supplemental Contributory 1 to 14 B.L.R.O. 1/2026. Pensions Trust Rules Made this 17th. day of Syaaban, 1447 Hijriah corresponding to the 5th. day of February, 2026.

DATIN SERI PADUKA HAJAH NOR HASHIMAH BINTI HAJI MUHAMMED TAIB Attorney General.
